rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: This MCP server provides a comprehensive bug bounty hunting and penetration testing toolkit built by Gokul, integrating 90+ security tools including Nuclei, Subfinder, Nmap, SQLMap, and OSINT platforms like Shodan and VirusTotal through a unified interface. The implementation features eight specialized tool categories (reconnaissance, scanning, vulnerability assessment, web application testing, network analysis, OSINT, exploitation, and reporting) with built-in safety mechanisms including target validation, rate limiting, and safe mode restrictions to prevent unauthorized testing. Designed with Docker deployment, extensive wordlist management, and configurable API integrations, it enables security researchers and penetration testers to conduct automated security assessments through natural language interactions with AI assistants, streamlining the entire bug bounty workflow from initial reconnaissance to vulnerability reporting.
